waveSysLines.line: 📺 WAVE LEDGER — wave 1 is halfway there (3/5 kills — the ledger counts kills only, not near-misses).
📺 WAVE LEDGER — wave 1's bar is full (5/5 — kills only, not near-misses). Wave 2 opens once day 8 passes.
📺 RATINGS ARE UP! The producers are pleased. New casting directives incoming — Wave 2 talent has been released into your sector.
📺 WAVE LEDGER — wave 2 is halfway there (2/4 kills — the ledger counts kills only, not near-misses).

📺 RATINGS ARE UP! The producers are pleased. New casting directives incoming — Wave 3 talent has been released into your sector.
📺 CONTEST: Siege. Hold the chokepoint for three waves while the village watches from the walls. The line holds, or you don't.
📺 Siege. Hold the chokepoint for three waves while the village watches from the walls. The line holds, or you don't.

📺 Siege. Hold the chokepoint for three waves while the village watches from the walls. The line holds, or you don't.

Almost nobody walks away from this one.

The lights come up. You can hear the crowd — millions of them, somewhere past the sky.

A chokepoint of rubble and light-fencing. Beyond it:

📺 The waves are coming. They feint at the barricade — and come for YOU.

The village gasps as one. Someone on the wall is screaming your name.

Three waves. Hold the line.
📺 3 gates. 3 waves. The crowd is a held breath.
📺 WAVE 2. The gate opens again. What comes out has seen the corpses and learned nothing, which is worse.
📺 Wave 1: The lead never reached Priya — it fell to the volley, and the pack's coordination shatters with it. (0 rounds, 0 taken)
📺 Wave 2: The lead never reached Priya — it fell to the volley, and the pack's coordination shatters with it. (0 rounds, 0 taken)
📺 Wave 3: The lead falls — the pack's coordination shatters. The rest scatter or die. (1 rounds, 0 taken)
